name: upgrade
body: Upgrade: bringing an existing kalide project — a deck directory or a template library directory — forward to the format and scaffold content of the running kalide, once and in place. The capability spans both authoring scaffold (the deck root: kalide.yaml, slides/, assets/ and the deck `AGENTS.md`) and templating (the library root: library.yaml, templates, themes, media and the library `AGENTS.md`), and is driven only by the current project's own files plus the running binary's version — never the network. It exists because kalide writes its scaffold content once (scaffold-deck, scaffold-template-library) and the format evolves: agent-guide-drift-check guards the guides at build time inside the repo but nothing refreshes a deployed project, so a project scaffolded by an older kalide can carry a stale guide or an old format. Conservative by construction: it recognizes what is still kalide's, rewrites only that, and reports the rest.
